items.name: SRM 1992 / ERM-FD305 certified zeta potential (certification uncertainty)

items.labs: 16 ELS datasets (plus 3 Z-PTA); 15 technically valid ELS datasets for mobility statistics
items.spread: Certified -58 mV with expanded uncertainty 5 mV (k = 2). This 5 mV is a COMBINED certification uncertainty (characterization + between-ampoule + stability), not a between-lab SD. items.held_same: ELS at 25 °C, ISO 13099-2:2012, borate buffer pH 9, same CRM ampoules; labs free to choose instrument
